name: io.github.chrischall/hellofresh-mcp
description: Unofficial HelloFresh (US) MCP for Claude — deliveries, menus, meal picks, skips and box sizes

environmentVariables.name: HELLOFRESH_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port. Defaults to the fleet-shared 37149.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_USER_TZ
environmentVariables.description: Your IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York), used for "this week" in hf_recent_picks. Defaults to the system zone.

environmentVariables.name: HELLOFRESH_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Truthy logs the fetchproxy bridge's role and lifecycle to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
environmentVariables.description: What a confirmation-gated write does on a client without a confirmation prompt: ask-user (default), auto, or refuse.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: on (default) confirms writes with an MCP elicitation prompt when the client supports one; off always uses the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE path.

environmentVariables.name: HELLOFRESH_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: Meal-planner profiles as an inline JSON array (wins over HELLOFRESH_PROFILES_FILE). Unset: the file, else the built-in couple/family profiles.

environmentVariables.name: HELLOFRESH_PROFILES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file of meal-planner profiles. Defaults to ~/.config/hellofresh-mcp/profiles.json, read only when it exists.
